beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the four adoption states before judging your own organization.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then read the visibility and permission chapters against one concrete working practice.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ask what became repeatable, what became acceptable, and what learning may have disappeared.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book's final direction shifts attention from identity battles toward accountable processes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: AI Adoption Beyond the Slop offers distinctions for examining that shift carefully.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it when loud opinions have made the actual pattern of useful work harder to see.
